## Verification

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] No secrets, private URLs, personal data, or credentials are included.
- [ ] New or adapted text is original or properly attributed.
- [ ] Sources and licenses are updated where needed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] The skill description still explains what it does and when to use it.
- [ ] I have read and followed the [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
